claim: Plan generated theories and ordinary auxiliary proof nodes around immutable contracts over verified environment data streams.

model.role: Propose generated theories, exact contract assignments, auxiliary intents and revisable ordering suggestions.

allowed_planner_inputs: verified public contracts with exact statements and contexts
original owner groups as provenance only
verified frozen-parent and retained-semantic premise records selected within the frozen context budget
forbidden_planner_inputs: raw human Refine theory sources or imports
deleted human helper names, statements, proof order or proof graph
private preparation inventories, recovery journals and checkpoints

rules.fixed_contracts: Every fixed contract occurs exactly once. Copy frozen statements/context/attributes; never accept model replacements.
rules.theory_grouping: Generated theory grouping is chosen by the planner. Auxiliary-only theories are allowed. Original owners are not output constraints.
rules.auxiliary_nodes: Ordinary unproved nodes serving contracts; may depend on other proposed nodes. No helper-leaf or cross-file commitment policy.
rules.suggested_dependencies: Revisable acyclic ordering hints, not certified dependencies or mandatory premise use. Theory grouping must also permit an acyclic order.
rules.premises: Cite only IDs in the visible legal premise input; no pending contract or auxiliary is usable as a premise.
rules.failure: The later proof stage may delete failed auxiliaries and their planning references; fixed contracts remain.
rules.validation: Structural planning validation only; precise statements and actual context/proof checking belong to file planning and Isabelle.
rules.context_budget: Preserve all contracts. Select premise records by deterministic lexical overlap then stable ID within the frozen total prompt budget; disclose omissions without claiming semantic symbol resolution.
